description: List installed mods (installedOnly=true) or search the gameserver's mod browser (e.g. CurseForge/Modrinth for Minecraft mod loaders, Thunderstore for Valheim, uMod for Rust with Oxide, ficsit for Satisfactory). Results carry provider, projectId and the installation state; install with install_gameserver_mod. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: list_gameserver_mods
title: List Game Server Mods
